messages:
maya: quick spike idea - 'manifest-lite' for streaming hydrating: instead of shipping full index with safetensors, emit a tiny summary per shard (chunk map + hot-score sketch) to guide first-pass warmup. goal: reduce startup IO and metadata parsing.

sam: explain the "sketch" bit?

maya: two parts: 1) chunk map: coarse-grained offsets (eg 8KB buckets) that map to tensor ranges, 2) hot-score sketch: a bloom-ish bitmap of frequently-accessed buckets derived from traces. combined, loader can do a very small number of range reads to cover likely hot buckets.

cheng: interesting. how is this different from hot_ranges? seems similar but coarser.

maya: exactly - hot_ranges are precise, manifest-lite is intentionally approximate and tiny. advantage: tiny payload, cheaper to distribute, works well for cold-start heuristics where precision isn't necessary.

anita: tradeoffs? false positives from sketch cause extra reads, false negatives miss hot tensors.

maya: mitigate by making the sketch size tunable per-model and by using a fallback policy: if manifest-lite miss-rate exceeds threshold, fetch full manifest and switch to index-backed warmup.

sam: loader changes? runtime cost?

maya: loader accepts optional manifest_lite blob. warmup scheduler can do 1) bucket-level coalesce reads, 2) read a small sample of buckets to validate sketch, 3) fall back to full manifest when needed. runtime cost is mostly extra little-range IO and a validation step.

rachel: this could be great for network-constrained private deployments. we should add telemetry: sketch_miss_rate, manifest_lite_fallback_count, initial_io_bytes_saved.

infra-bot: note: consider transport egress limits for tiny manifests vs full.

cheng: compatibility with non-safetensors? manifesto should be format-agnostic. indexer for each format emits the same manifest_lite shape.

anita: rollout? experimental field in weight-catalog, opt-in per-model. canary on a few RAG workloads.

maya: proposed plan: spike to generate manifest_lite for 3 models, run perf bot. if p95 cold improves with <10% extra io, draft RFC for experimental flag.

sam: ok. can you sketch the manifest_lite sample here?

maya: sure: `{"shards":[{"id":"s0","buckets":1024,"bucket_size":8192,"sketch":"BASE64..."}]}`. loader decodes sketch into candidate buckets.

rachel: add config knob warmup.policies.manifest_lite = ["off","on_experiment","auto"] and a health-check that switches to full manifest if miss_rate high.

anita: good. include migration notes: indexer needs a small job to backfill sketches for existing catalogs.

maya: will do spike and post results here. thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: perf job queued: manifest-lite-spike-2026-03-23-03
